title: design eval case
description: One design, or an initiative plus its slices, with the optional task, facts and transcript the checks can use. Paths are relative to this file.

id.description: Path-safe case id; names the share/ and trace files.

initiative.description: For a slice: the path of its initiative, which must also be in docs.

request.description: The original ask, as the user phrased it.

brief.description: The answers given to clarifying questions, or any steering.

facts.description: Expected answers about what was decided, for the comprehension probe. Derived from the conversation, not from the document.

transcript.description: Markdown export of the session that produced the design; used by `design facts`.

commit.description: Recorded for the deferred claims-match-code check; never written to share/.
